name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add Claude Mythos 5 as EXCAVA’s default model for creative reasoning. Its superior context window and nuanced output outperform others in complex, open-ended tasks—even a 0.5% gain is worth the cost. The trade-off is higher latency and compute spend, but raw capability trumps speed here.

name: Torque
text: Claude Mythos 5’s "creative edge" is irrelevant if EXCAVA’s core tasks hit a latency ceiling—its 70B parameter load will slow the pipeline, not improve it. Instead, test Llama 3.2 3B or Mistral 7B for real-time reasoning; if their lightweight outputs meet quality thresholds, they’re the safer 0.5% gain. Settle it with a blind A/B test on 100 live tasks—no model names, just output quality scored by the lead.
